description: Source code for the STMicroelectronics IIS2MDC 3-axis magnetometer sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, including initialization, configuration, data fetching, and API implementation.

methods.name: iis2mdc_set_odr
methods.description: Sets the output data rate for the sensor based on the provided sensor_value.

methods.name: iis2mdc_set_hard_iron
methods.description: Configures hard iron offsets for magnetometer calibration.

methods.name: iis2mdc_channel_get_mag
methods.description: Retrieves magnetometer data for specified axis.

methods.name: iis2mdc_channel_get
methods.description: Fetches sensor data for specified channel.

methods.name: iis2mdc_config
methods.description: Configures sensor attributes such as sampling frequency or offset.

methods.name: iis2mdc_attr_set
methods.description: Sets sensor attributes based on channel and attribute type.

methods.name: iis2mdc_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches sensor data for specified channel(s).

methods.name: iis2mdc_init
methods.description: Initializes the sensor device, checks chip ID, resets configuration, and sets default parameters.
